# Cliffco Mortgage Bankers — NJ First Generation Homebuyer Program

> Cliffco Mortgage Bankers (NMLS #65328) helps New Jersey buyers apply for the NJHMFA First Generation Homebuyer Program, which provides up to $22,000 toward a down payment or closing costs when combined with NJHMFA's Smart Start Down Payment Assistance Program and an NJHMFA first mortgage.

## Key facts

- Program administrator: New Jersey Housing and Mortgage Finance Agency (NJHMFA), a State of New Jersey agency. Cliffco is not NJHMFA and does not set eligibility or fund availability.
- First Generation Homebuyer component: $7,000 toward down payment/closing costs.
- Combined with NJHMFA Smart Start DPA: up to $22,000 total in 12 counties (Bergen, Essex, Hudson, Hunterdon, Mercer, Middlesex, Monmouth, Morris, Ocean, Passaic, Somerset, Union); up to $17,000 total in the remaining 9 counties (Atlantic, Burlington, Camden, Cape May, Cumberland, Gloucester, Salem, Sussex, Warren).
- Structure: forgivable loan, 0% interest, no monthly payments, forgiven after 5 years of owner-occupancy without refinancing.
- Must be paired with an NJHMFA first mortgage loan; not available as a standalone grant.
- Eligibility: first-time homebuyer whose parents/guardians have no present ownership interest in any residential property, and whose spouse/domestic partner hasn't owned a primary residence in the past 3 years — OR anyone who was in foster care, an emancipated youth, or a homeless/unaccompanied youth under the McKinney-Vento Act.
- Contact: Eddie Morais (NMLS #243926) and Gary Johansen (NMLS #339278), both licensed New Jersey loan officers at Cliffco Mortgage Bankers.
